label: DAY 40
title: AI plays my plane boarding game. Back-to-front lost to random in 10,000 flights.

lines.text: Planes board back rows first. That's the smart way, right?
My bot tried it. Watch the amber jam in the aisle.
Everyone stows a bag at once, in one narrow aisle.
Five bots, ten thousand flights each. Same passengers, same bags.
Pure random order beat back-to-front in every single flight.
Window seats first, every other row, starting from the back.
Ten people stow bags side by side. Same plane: 3:37 instead of 7:57.

scenes.text: A physicist, Jason Steffen, proposed this order in 2008. A real test in 2011 agreed.
scenes.sub: Would you line up by seat number?
